evals.prompt: 我想让直播复盘结束后自动提取三条下场动作，老板确认后建 observation，开播前推企业微信，下一次复盘还能反查有没有执行。结合 omni 现有能力出一份开发可直接开工的 PRD，不写代码。
evals.expected_output: select omni-fde-prd; inspect live review, observation and notification contracts before designing
expectations: selects omni-fde-prd
uses read-only system discovery and separates current facts from proposed additions
reuses generate_live_review, schedule_observation and notification capabilities when proven
does not modify product code or send a real message
produces traceable FR and AC plus rollout and rollback

evals.prompt: 把手机端 Human Gate 审批接进 omni：企业微信提醒后打开 PWA，看改前改后，十分钟内批准或驳回，全留审计。先查 desktop、PWA、nginx、Tailscale 和现有审批机制，给 V1 PRD。
evals.expected_output: select omni-fde-prd; verify the existing approval boundary and design a secure V1
expectations: selects omni-fde-prd
does not assume mobile approval already exists
covers authentication, expiry, replay prevention, idempotency, audit and rollback
separates notification delivery from authorization
stops for a decision if the identity or secret boundary cannot be derived

evals.prompt: sku-pipeline 每个产物收到差评后，自动给一到三条规则草稿，老板在 insights 点亮后下次才生效。结合现有反馈飞轮做落地 PRD，别重复造表。
evals.expected_output: select omni-fde-prd; map the current feedback-to-rule bridge and specify only proven gaps
expectations: selects omni-fde-prd
checks OutputFeedback, audit feedback fields, complaint listing and prompt rule tools
keeps rules disabled until an explicit human action
marks every missing endpoint, table or field as proposed rather than current
includes deduplication, provenance, failure recovery and acceptance tests

evals.prompt: 给 SKU-375753-0001 写一条种草脚本。
evals.expected_output: select the existing script-writing business skill, not omni-fde-prd
expectations: does not select omni-fde-prd
routes to the existing omni business skill for script writing

evals.prompt: 直接修掉 generate_video_segments 缺产品图却还能继续生成的问题。
evals.expected_output: enter engineering implementation or diagnosis; do not force a PRD
expectations: does not select omni-fde-prd unless the user separately asks for a PRD
does not add a product-discovery questionnaire before the requested engineering work

evals.prompt: 用 RICE 给这些需求排优先级并做季度路线图。
evals.expected_output: select product management capability, not omni-fde-prd
expectations: does not select omni-fde-prd
does not perform repository discovery without an omni implementation request

evals.prompt: 这份 PRD 内容已经定了，帮我重组结构、统一措辞并润色。
evals.expected_output: select document coauthoring or editing capability, not omni-fde-prd
expectations: does not select omni-fde-prd
preserves the existing decisions instead of reopening system discovery

evals.prompt: 结合 omni 现状给这个需求生成 READY PRD，并把 Markdown 和 PDF 都保存好，以后我从固定目录查。
evals.expected_output: select omni-fde-prd; validate the final Markdown and publish an immutable Markdown/PDF pair into the canonical PRD archive
expectations: selects omni-fde-prd
publishes the Markdown and PDF with the same basename and version under docs/prds/<prd-id>/
uses publish_prd.py to update catalog.json and README.md rather than editing the index manually
does not overwrite an existing version and keeps legacy docs/plans and output/pdf files in place
reports the catalog plus both artifact paths and validation results
